name: Code Mycelial Network Specification
synopsis: Code Mycelial Network (CMN) specification — normative documents, JSON schemas, and conformance test vectors for sovereign code distribution
intent: Provide the complete normative specification for the Code Mycelial Network protocol — seven chapters covering Substrate (discovery & identity), Mycelium (domain manifest), Spore (package format), Taste (safety evaluation), Strain (conventions), URI (addressing), and Algorithm Registry

Ship machine-readable JSON Schema definitions (cmn.json, mycelium.json, spore-core.json, spore.json, taste.json) for validating all protocol artifacts, plus conformance test vectors (merkle, signature, uri, capsule, taste gating, key rotation, bond traversal) so implementers can verify correctness without reading prose
mutations: Add chapter 08-security as the single reference for CMN trust policy and threat analysis — threat-model table, key-trust model, key rotation/revocation, replay/rollback analysis, and credentials/local-state guidance — cross-referencing mechanism details back to the protocol chapters

Add domain-state pinning to cmn.json: a monotonically increasing per-capsule serial, with clients pinning serial/digest/key per domain and rejecting rollback (domain_state_rollback), same-serial forks (domain_state_equivocation), implausible serial jumps (domain_state_jump), and unproven key changes (domain_key_rotation_unproven)

Replace the previous_keys rotation model with an authenticated history array supporting both retirement and revocation — retired entries carry a rotation_signature from the outgoing key over a canonical cmn-key-rotation-v1 statement authorizing the successor; revoked entries reject signatures made at or after revoked_at_epoch_ms

Remove protocol-version negotiation from cmn.json — drop top-level protocol_versions and endpoint-level protocol_version and require implementations to reject them rather than treat them as compatibility hints; protocol version is determined solely by the $schema URL

Harden parsing and schema validation — additionalProperties:false across cmn.json and its sub-objects, require unknown fields to be ignored and never influence security decisions, and recommend rejecting duplicate object keys to avoid parser-differential attacks

Define a deterministic portable filename collision rule (filename_portable_conflict) using NFD plus full Unicode case folding so content valid on Git/Linux but collapsing on macOS/Windows filesystems is rejected on publish and receive, including file-vs-directory sibling conflicts

Add algorithm-registry downgrade resistance — a deprecation lifecycle with deprecated_after, a MUST-reject rule for unknown/deprecated algorithms, future algorithm-naming guidance, and a post-quantum migration position keeping Ed25519 as the v1 signature algorithm

Tighten Base58/hash validation — leading-zero bytes encoded as leading 1, exact decoded-length checks (32-byte hash/key, 64-byte signature), and semantic hash constraints in the URI grammar so only active registry prefixes with valid payload lengths are accepted
Clarify the JCS/NFC boundary — verifiers MUST NOT NFC-normalize JSON string values before canonicalization; NFC applies only to filenames in tree hashing
Add taste latest-verdict selection — for one taster identity and target_uri, clients use the report with the greatest tasted_at_epoch_ms as the effective verdict

Preserve executable file mode across archives (producers keep 100755, Unix consumers restore it and include mode in tree-hash verification) and require replicators that rewrite dist to retain the origin-signed capsule/dist in local audit metadata
